title_en: Liam's Map's Fee at $80k, Flightline to Be Determined

title_en: Breeders' Cup Foal Nominations Close Oct. 15
description: Breeders' Cup Limited issued a reminder that Oct. 15, at 11:59 p.m. ET, is the final deadline to nominate foals born in 2026 to the Breeders' Cup program at the one-time nomination fee of $400.

title_en: Jockey Club Names T.I.P. Non-Competition Award Winners
description: The Jockey Club Thoroughbred Incentive Program announced Oct. 12 the recipients and honorees of its two non-competition awards, the T.I.P. Thoroughbred of the Year Award and the T.I.P. Young Rider of the Year Award, for 2026.

description: The top two finishers of the Oct. 1 Joe Hirsch Turf Classic (G1T), Minaret Station and Far Bridge, are expected to be nominees to face Calandagan as he seeks to win the Japan Cup (G1) for a second straight year Nov. 29.

title_en: First-Crop Weanlings Highlight F-T Saratoga Mixed Sale
description: The one-day auction offers a variety of New York-bred weanlings and a handful of broodmares in foal to attractive stallions.

title_en: Time to Dazzle Repeats in Thrilling Franklin Stakes
description: Unleashing her trademark late kick, 5-year-old Time to Dazzle lived up to her name, charging from the back of the pack to capture the $400,000 Franklin Stakes (G2T) Oct. 11 at Keeneland for the second year in a row.

title_en: Magic Millions Launch Bumper Week for Breeze-Up Market
description: An unusually busy week for the Australasian horses-in-training market gets underway Oct. 12 when Magic Millions stages its Gold Coast auction, just three days before Inglis hosts its Ready2Race Sale at Riverside Stables.

title_en: Bauer Contemplates Next Race for Tam Tam
description: Now that Tam Tam is a two-time grade 1 winner, trainer Phil Bauer is weighing making an attempt at a third in the Dec. 26 American Oaks (G1T) or waiting for her 4-year-old campaign.

title_en: Champions Crowned at Thoroughbred Makeover
description: Ten champions were crowned at the 2026 Thoroughbred Makeover and National Symposium, which came to a close Oct. 10.

title_en: Ortiz Ready for Riding Debut at Keeneland
description: Yomar Ortiz Jr., a 17-year-old son of a jockey, is set to make his own riding debut on one of racing's biggest stages, Keeneland, Oct. 14.

title_en: Grade 1 Winner Tom's d'Etat Dies After Brief Illness
description: Grade 1 winner and stallion Tom's d'Etat has died following a brief illness, GMB Racing's Greg Bensel said in an Oct. 11 post on X. He was 13.

title_en: Tattersalls Notebook: Americans Have Banner Book 1
description: The last few years American buyers have flirted with setting new benchmarks when they participate in Book 1 of the Tattersalls October Yearling Sale. This year, the spending record fell and the mark for lots bought was matched.

title_en: Forever Young, Phileas Fogg Work at Belmont for Classic
description: Reigning Breeders' Cup Classic (G1) winner Forever Young and Suburban Stakes (G2) winner Phileas Fogg put in works at Belmont Park in preparation for the Breeders' Cup Classic Oct. 31 at Keeneland.

title_en: Tattersalls October Yearling Sale Book 2 Begins Oct. 12
description: Reminders of Book 2 have been appearing in equine form across Newmarket lately as the bloodstock world readied itself for the next stage of the Tattersalls October Yearling Sale Oct. 12-14.

title_en: DeVaux Starts Foundation to Support Education, TBreds
description: Trainer Cherie DeVaux has established a non-profit foundation to provide educational scholarships to students pursuing careers in the equine industry and to support organizations dedicated to rescuing and protecting at-risk Thoroughbreds.

title_en: Warwoven Notches Elite Double in Caulfield Guineas Win
description: Warwoven now sits on top of the world as Australia's preeminent 3-year-old after becoming just the fourth horse to complete the Golden Rose (G1)-Caulfield Guineas (G1) double Oct. 10 at Caulfield Racecourse.

description: California Distaff Handicap

description: Amtote Open Derby

title_en: Third Coast Seizes Winning Trip in Hill Prince
description: As far as a pace setup goes, it was a perfect one for jockey Jose Lezcano and Glen Hill Farm's homebred Third Coast in the Hill Prince Stakes (G3T) Oct. 10 at Belmont Park.

title_en: Canadian Jockey Wilson Rides 2,000th Winner
description: Emma-Jayne Wilson, one of the most accomplished female jockeys in Thoroughbred racing history, reaches a milestone of riding 2,000 winners by piloting Vanity to victory in the seventh race Oct. 10 at Woodbine.

title_en: Tam Tam Cruises on Lead to Take Queen Elizabeth II
description: Tam Tam went for the early lead in the Queen Elizabeth II Challenge Cup Stakes (G1T) Oct. 10 at Keeneland and never let up, as the Phil Bauer-trained filly won her second straight grade 1 event after taking the Del Mar Oaks (G1T) Aug. 22 at Del Mar.

title_en: Prat Gets Feel for Magnitude With Breeze at Keeneland
description: Preparing for riding Magnitude in the Oct. 31 Breeders' Cup Classic (G1) at Keeneland, jockey Flavien Prat put the colt through a 5-furlong in-company breeze in 1:00 3/5 Oct. 10 at the Lexington track.

title_en: Laurel Reschedules Oct. 11 Card Due to Expected Storm
description: Due to expected weather from Hurricane Isaias affecting the Mid-Atlantic region, Laurel Park has rescheduled the Oct. 11 live racing program. The nine-race card will be run in full without a redraw Oct. 15.

title_en: Steve, Erik Asmussen Team Up for Five Wins at Remington
description: Hall of Fame trainer Steve Asmussen and his son, Erik, win five races together Oct. 9 at Remington Park.

title_en: Darkness Falls Shines in Dewhurst Stakes
description: Darkness Falls wins the Oct. 10 Dewhurst Stakes (G1) for Aidan O'Brien and Ryan Moore. The talented juvenile shows determination to outrun Desert Castle, who finished close behind.

title_en: Lambeth Captures First Graded Win in Sycamore Stakes
description: The 5-year-old son of Arrogate came into the race off a 2 1/16-mile contest at Kentucky Downs. Trainer Joe Sharp said the horse told him, through his conditioning and energy, he was ready for the 1 1/2-mile Sycamore Stakes (G2T).

title_en: Gov. Moore Hails Maryland Horse Industry Strategic Plan
description: Maryland Gov. Wes Moore announces the completion of the Maryland Horse Industry Strategic Plan, marking a major milestone in a statewide effort to benefit Maryland's horse industry and establish a shared path for its continued growth.

title_en: Gulfstream Schedule Out; Pegasus Purses Being Finalized
description: Gulfstream Park's 2026-27 Championship Meet will offer a winter schedule of 66 stakes—27 graded—and will be highlighted by the 11th running of the Pegasus World Cup Invitational Stakes (G1) Jan. 30.

title_en: NY Gaming Commission Authorizes Claiming Purse Increase
description: The NYSGC receives an update on advanced diagnostic imaging intended to identify potential injuries in racehorses, reviews barn fire safety efforts, and authorizes consideration of an increase in the purse-to-claiming-price ratio for claiming races.

title_en: Coolmore, Godolphin Juveniles Face Off in Dewhurst
description: Godolphin and Coolmore have been implacable rivals all week across town at Tattersalls, and that rivalry shifts to the racecourse Oct. 10 as the stables each have multiple entries in the Dewhurst Stakes (G1) at Newmarket Racecourse.

title_en: Musical Times Overcomes Adversity to Win Fillies' Mile
description: Musical Times overcame some serious traffic issues to remain unbeaten and enhance her classic claims in the Fillies' Mile Stakes (G1) Oct. 9 at Newmarket Racecourse.

title_en: Retired Jockey Court Joins Oaklawn in Integrity Role
description: Two and a half years after his final ride May 5, 2024, at Oaklawn Park, retired jockey Jon Court is returning to the Hot Springs, Ark., track in a new capacity.

title_en: Connections Lean Toward Classic for The Puma After Work
description: With three weeks until the Breeders' Cup, The Puma and Englishman record important works Oct. 9 at Keeneland.

title_en: Mister Omaha Set to Shine in Oklahoma Classics Cup
description: The state's richest night of Thoroughbred racing for Oklahoma-breds, the Oklahoma Classics, has been drawn for racing Oct. 16. The card is led by the Classics Cup Handicap at 1 1/16 miles.

title_en: D I Wire Favored in New York Breeders' Futurity
description: D I Wire looks to add more black type to his resume when he returns to Finger Lakes Oct. 12 to run in the $176,238 New York Breeders' Futurity.

title_en: Vazquez, Kravets Hit 4,000-Win Milestones
description: Jockey Ramon Vazquez and trainer Bruce Kravets notch their 4,000th career victories Oct. 8.

title_en: Dual Arc Winner Daryz Retired From Racing
description: The Aga Khan Studs announces the retirement of Daryz, five days after the 4-year-old won a second consecutive running of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe (G1).

title_en: Most Wanted Enters Stud in New York for Joint Venture
description: Graded stakes winner Most Wanted enters stud next year in a joint venture for three of New York's largest breeding farms: Irish Hill Century Farm, Hidden Lake Farm, and Stonegate Farm/Turning Point Bloodstock.

title_en: Teachintherelease Aims for WV Breeders' Classic Repeat
description: Defending winner Teachintherelease headlines an expected full field of 10 (with two alternates) in this year's renewal of the $300,000 Sam Huff West Virginia Breeders' Classic Stakes Oct. 10 at Hollywood Casino at Charles Town Races.

title_en: Curlin to Return to Service on Hill 'n' Dale '27 Roster
description: Hill 'n' Dale at Xalapa announced Oct. 7 its stud fees for the 2027 breeding season, with two-time Horse of the Year and breed-shaping sire Curlin leading the roster.

title_en: Jump Seat Soars in Second Start as Hot Prospect
description: Godolphin's Jump Seat, a half sister to dual champion Essential Quality and by 2022 Horse of the Year Flightline, is the latest BloodHorse Maiden Watch Hot Prospect after a 2 1/4-length victory Oct. 7 at Keeneland.

title_en: Q&A: Thompson Aims to Expand Regional Breeding Markets
description: In a Q&A with BloodHorse, Najja Thompson discusses his new role as director of state breeder and provincial programs for The Jockey Club.

title_en: G1 Winner, Social Media Star Sandman Retired
